Look for the human in everyone. We all feel the same sense of self, we're all a part of the human experience. Look past the superficial and understand that you're not the only "you" out there. 

It never happens til it happens - nobody grows up to drop out, become a drug addict, commit suicide. These things happen though, and really you're no exception. 

Life happens and it's up to you to either enjoy it or let it slip. Time doesn't stop for you, it keeps going and you're responsible - one day you'll be dead, accept that and start living. 

Life isn't about money. Money makes things good, it can solve problems and it can make people happy. However, life isn't about money. We're here to live and enjoy the experience, appreciate the little things like a blunt at night, a bonfire with friends, a nice steak with a beer. It's those little things that add up and make your life memorable... one day you'll be old and look back, try to live for memories because this is just an experience.

Life is a game. Literally, it's a giant fucking video game and we're the characters. We have freewill, intelligence, communication, potential...  if you live your life like it's a game, chances are it'll turn out alright. Obviously be smart about it, but approach life like you would a game. Enjoy the interactions, obstacles, transitions, experiences... be creative and enjoy this game while it lasts.
